title: 第14章 住行无忧
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年

第(1/3)页

穿越倒计时：3天。

“谭小姐是吧？欢迎您来线下体验，我是这次负责接待您的工作人员，你叫我小王就可以了。”

“好的。”

谭筝跟着小王往体验基地里走，没走多远，几栋造型各异的轻钢别墅便映入眼帘。

有简约现代的平层款式，线条利落流畅，大面积玻璃窗通透亮眼；也有雅致的双层洋房，搭配休闲露台与错落屋檐。

各式户型风格分明，做工精致，丝毫不输传统住宅。

“谭小姐，你看看，你对哪个户型更感兴趣，我可以带你进入内部参观，并为你重点介绍。”

谭筝犹豫了一会，选择了就近的一栋。

“先看看这个吧。”

“好的，您稍等。”

小王从包里掏出钥匙

屋内空间敞亮，采光充足，厨卫、卧室布局规整，基础软装一应俱全，看着整洁又舒适。

“搭建这种轻钢别墅，是不是得先把场地推平，打好地基才行？”

“没错，只要是建房，地基都是重中之重，地基处理不到位，房子再结实也稳不住。”

谭筝缓步在屋内走了一圈，暗自琢磨。

穿越回古代，无论是荒郊野外还算村庄城镇，都很难找到这么一大块平整的土地用来放置别墅，光是第一步就卡住了。

“嗯……那这房子是成品整体吊装过来，还是下单后再现场拼接零部件？”

“我们这需要根据您选定的户型、风格备好材料，再运输到现场进行统一组装搭建。”

“那这个组装大概要多长时间？”

“正常工期差不多一个月。”

“要这么久？”

谭筝这才发觉自己之前把事情想得太过简单，综合来看，轻钢别墅似乎并不适合自己。

她稍作停顿，借口道：“我有点口渴，麻烦你帮我倒杯水吧。”

“没问题，您稍等。”小王应声，转身离开。

Page (1/3)

Countdown to time travel: 3 days.

"Miss Tan, right? You are welcome to experience it offline. I am the staff responsible for receiving you this time. You can just call me Xiao Wang."

"Okay."

Tan Zheng followed Xiao Wang to the experience base. Not far away, several light steel villas of different shapes came into view.

There are simple and modern flat-floor styles with neat and smooth lines and large glass windows that are bright and transparent; there are also elegant double-story bungalows with leisure terraces and scattered eaves.

Various house types have distinct styles and exquisite workmanship, no less than traditional houses.

"Ms. Tan, take a look and see which apartment type you are more interested in. I can take you inside to see it and introduce it to you."

Tan Zheng hesitated for a while and chose the nearest one.

"Let's take a look at this first."

"Okay, please wait a moment."

Xiao Wang took out the key from his bag

The interior of the house is open and bright, with ample lighting. The kitchen, bathroom, and bedrooms are neatly laid out, and all basic soft furnishings are available. It looks neat and comfortable.

"To build this kind of light steel villa, do we have to level the site and lay a good foundation first?"

"Yes, as long as you are building a house, the foundation is the top priority. If the foundation is not properly handled, the house will not be stable no matter how strong it is."

Tan Zheng walked slowly around the house, thinking to himself.

Traveling back to ancient times, it was difficult to find such a large piece of flat land to place a villa, whether it was in the wilderness or in a village or town. The first step alone was enough to get stuck.

"Hmm... So is this house going to be hoisted as a whole as a finished product, or will the parts be assembled on site after the order is placed?"

"We need to prepare materials according to the house type and style you selected, and then transport them to the site for unified assembly and construction."

"How long does it take to assemble this?"

"The normal construction period is about one month."

"It takes so long?"

Only then did Tan Zheng realize that he had thought about things too simply. Overall, the light steel villa seemed not suitable for him.

She paused for a moment and excused herself: "I'm a little thirsty. Could you please pour me a glass of water?"

"No problem, please wait a moment." Xiao Wang responded, turned and left.
